title: Define moderation & dispute boundaries

externalAuthorities.creative: 420 Creative Protocol remains authoritative for Work/Recording/Creator publication and music-rights state
externalAuthorities.rights: 420 Rights remains authoritative for canonical rights claims/licenses/provenance; competing legal claims are not decided by 420Hz moderation
externalAuthorities.arbitration: 420Arbitration owns registered domain-scoped case/ruling/finality state only when explicitly adopted
externalAuthorities.charts: 420Hz Charts remains derived ranking; moderation may exclude invalid inputs under policy but cannot hand-edit rank
externalAuthorities.awards: 420Hz Awards owns canonical product-domain nomination/ballot/vote/result history

rules: reporterActorRef must match the qualified Wallet/session actor when the report is not anonymous-by-policy
a report is allegation/intake only and creates no canonical finding, rights change, payment action, Identity sanction or Award result change
target type/id must resolve to an eligible 420Hz target and may not be substituted by arbitrary external objects
duplicate/replayed report submissions are idempotent or rejected without duplicate enforcement
report spam/rate abuse may be bounded without changing the truth of existing reports

evidenceRules: evidence may remain encrypted/access-controlled off-chain and should be referenced by commitment rather than embedded publicly
an evidence hash/commitment does not make the underlying payload public or authorize disclosure
authorized evidence viewers are case/role scoped and least privilege
evidence retention follows HZ-GCA-1.8 and may be extended only by a scoped active appeal/dispute hold
late, missing, forged, altered or unverifiable evidence is handled by explicit policy rather than presumed true
raw Identity proofs, wallet secrets, private generation inputs, private consent evidence and unrelated private community data must not enter public moderation records

enforcementSemantics.HIDE: remove ordinary 420Hz read/discovery visibility while preserving target identity/history and authorized review access
enforcementSemantics.LOCK: preserve eligible read visibility while disabling further 420Hz interaction/mutation paths for the target
enforcementSemantics.SUSPEND: disable defined 420Hz mutation/participation capability for the subject within the scoped app/domain; does not revoke protocol Identity or Wallet
enforcementSemantics.BLOCK: user-scoped relationship/access suppression preventing the blocked relationship from being used as an alternate interaction path
enforcementSemantics.MUTE: user-scoped presentation suppression for the muting user only
enforcementSemantics.RESTORE: release active app enforcement while preserving full prior moderation history

enforcementRules: HIDE/LOCK/SUSPEND are application enforcement only and cannot alter Creative/Rights ownership, canonical Recording/Work IDs, Wallet authority, Identity credentials, payment balances or governance state
BLOCK/MUTE do not fabricate follow/unfollow/favorite mutations and do not alter Commons/Town membership or protocol Identity
enforcement scope is explicit to target/app/domain and cannot silently spread to unrelated recordings, creators, projects, communities or ballots
Search/Indexer projections must respect active HIDE/visibility enforcement and cannot resurrect hidden/tombstoned state
RESTORE never deletes the prior report/decision/appeal history
moderatorRules: moderation decisions require an explicitly authorized 420Hz moderation capability/role bound to the target domain
reporter, target owner, ordinary Wallet user, provider, chart operator or Awards participant cannot self-promote into moderator authority
moderator authority is not transferable to Wallet, Rights, Identity, payment or Governance domains
moderation decisions are append-only/versioned and preserve actor, action, reason, evidence references and timestamps
a moderator cannot directly alter a finalized AwardResult or immutable Creative/Rights record
appeals: only an affected subject or otherwise policy-authorized party may appeal an application moderation decision
appeal is linked to the prior decision and never overwrites history
appeal windows/limits must be explicit and frozen for the case/policy before enforcement becomes appealable
appeal reviewer authority must be distinct/scoped by policy and cannot be inferred from reporter status
RESTORE or revised enforcement requires a new decision after appeal review; it does not erase earlier state
commentsBoundary: comments/replies may be enabled only after REPORT/BLOCK/MUTE/HIDE/LOCK/APPEAL paths are implemented and qualified for that surface
comment moderation must retain stable actor/target references, replay protection and source visibility bounds
enabling comments without reporting/appeal/moderation support is invalid
rightsDisputes: rights/provenance complaint may cause temporary HIDE/LOCK or publication-review hold in 420Hz but does not rewrite Creative/Rights state
non-identical competing Rights claims remain preserved by 420 Rights; 420Hz does not choose a legal winner from UI/indexer metadata
where an explicit Arbitration domain is adopted, a Rights dispute may reference/open a domain-scoped Arbitration case against the exact originating component/object
a finalized Arbitration ruling cannot directly rewrite Rights; any Rights-consuming remedy requires an explicit exact-right transition in the owning protocol
until canonical source state is resolved/revalidated, public 420Hz availability may fail closed under the applicable publication/right policy
awardsChallenges: Award challenge types include eligibility challenge, nomination challenge, ballot-integrity challenge, vote-abuse challenge and result-correction request
ordinary moderation may hide abusive presentation or pause unresolved participation where policy allows but cannot hand-edit tallies or winner identities
pre-finalization objective invalidation may only use rules frozen in the season/category/voting policy and must retain reason/evidence commitments
post-finalization correction cannot mutate historical AwardResult bytes; it requires an explicit superseding result/history path
prize state cannot decide the validity of an Awards challenge or result correction
Chart/community popularity cannot substitute for evidence in an Awards challenge
voteAbuseRules: suspected duplicate/replay/Sybil/manipulation evidence may flag, quarantine or challenge affected vote inputs under the frozen HZ-GCA-1.13 policy
moderation cannot create voter eligibility, fabricate a nullifier, change a valid vote choice or silently delete valid votes
vote invalidation requires objective reason/evidence tied to the exact ballot/vote/policy and durable audit history
rate/anomaly scores are evidence inputs only and never sole canonical authority unless the frozen policy explicitly defines an objective threshold
final tally correction follows deterministic recomputation from accepted/invalidated canonical vote state, not operator-edited totals

rules: 420Arbitration is not automatically invoked by a 420Hz report, appeal, rights complaint or Award challenge
Arbitration integration requires a registered domain plus exact origin component/object and explicit HZ consumption policy
opening an Arbitration case records a dispute and is not a ruling
only claimant/respondent may submit evidence/appeal and only the selected resolver may rule under the snapshotted Arbitration policy
a finalized ruling is a bounded input; 420Hz must verify expected domain/origin/parties/finality/ruling/remedy/replay before consuming it
420Hz consuming logic remains responsible for its own authorization/state transition and may consume only explicitly enumerated remedies
Arbitration cannot directly seize funds, rewrite Rights, alter Awards history, grant Wallet/Identity authority or override Governance
unresolved/deprecated/wrong-service/unverified Arbitration bindings fail closed if the chosen 420Hz policy requires Arbitration

privacyAndRetention: moderation reports, appeals and evidence visibility follow the narrowest applicable privacy class
public moderation summaries may disclose only policy-approved reason/status metadata and non-sensitive commitments
private evidence payloads are excluded from public Search/Indexer/Analytics and notification content
case-specific evidence hold follows HZ-GCA-1.8 scoped dispute retention and cannot retain unrelated project data
deletion of application-visible report content does not erase immutable external Arbitration/Creative/Rights history where such history legitimately exists
searchNotificationRules: Search may suppress or remove active hidden/ineligible public projections but cannot mutate moderation or source state
Notifications may deliver report/decision/appeal/challenge events only to eligible recipients under privacy/opt-in policy
notification delivery failure cannot roll back a moderation decision or Arbitration state
a notification action/deep link cannot bypass Wallet/session/moderator/appeal authorization
failureRules: report target substitution or actor mismatch fails closed
duplicate/replayed report cannot create duplicate enforcement
moderation without scoped moderator authority fails closed
HIDE/LOCK/SUSPEND attempting to rewrite Creative/Rights/Wallet/Identity/payment/governance state is invalid
BLOCK/MUTE fabricating follow/membership/Identity mutations is invalid
appeal overwriting prior decision history is invalid
comments/replies enabled without report/block/mute/appeal support is invalid
operator/manual Awards tally or winner edit is invalid
vote invalidation without objective reason/evidence and policy binding is invalid
finalized AwardResult in-place mutation is invalid
Arbitration auto-invocation from ordinary moderation/report state is invalid
Arbitration ruling consumed without exact domain/origin/finality/replay validation fails closed
Arbitration remedy outside the explicit 420Hz allowlist fails closed
private evidence publication from commitment alone is invalid
Search/Notifications state cannot override moderation/source authority
invariants: HZGCA-MOD-001 moderation owns only 420Hz application enforcement/report/appeal state and never Creative/Rights/Identity/Wallet/payment/governance authority
HZGCA-MOD-002 reports are allegations/intake and never canonical findings by themselves
HZGCA-MOD-003 moderation decisions require scoped moderator authority and append-only audit history
HZGCA-MOD-004 HIDE/LOCK/SUSPEND alter only application visibility/interactivity/participation within explicit scope
HZGCA-MOD-005 BLOCK/MUTE are user/app relationship controls and never fabricate source social or protocol identity state
HZGCA-MOD-006 appeals preserve prior reports/decisions and require authorized affected-party/reviewer paths
HZGCA-MOD-007 comments/replies remain disabled until moderation/report/appeal boundaries for that surface are qualified
HZGCA-MOD-008 private evidence remains private; a commitment never grants disclosure authority
HZGCA-MOD-009 rights disputes may fail closed application publication but cannot cause 420Hz to rewrite Creative/Rights truth
HZGCA-MOD-010 Awards challenges cannot hand-edit tallies, votes, winners or finalized result bytes
HZGCA-MOD-011 vote invalidation requires objective ballot/policy-bound evidence and deterministic retally
HZGCA-MOD-012 post-finalization Awards correction uses explicit superseding history, never in-place mutation
HZGCA-MOD-013 420Arbitration is optional/explicit and is never automatically invoked by ordinary moderation
HZGCA-MOD-014 Arbitration case opening is not a ruling and finalized rulings are bounded evidence inputs only
HZGCA-MOD-015 Arbitration remedy consumption is domain/origin/finality/replay checked and allowlisted by the owning 420Hz transition
HZGCA-MOD-016 Arbitration cannot directly move funds, rewrite Rights/Awards history, mutate Identity/Wallet or execute Governance
HZGCA-MOD-017 Search/Indexer/Notifications remain projections/delivery and cannot override moderation or source truth
HZGCA-MOD-018 moderation/dispute policy creates no new custody, Rights, Identity, payment, governance, Charts or Arbitration resolver authority
exitCriteria: moderation vocabulary and application enforcement semantics are explicit
report/evidence/decision/appeal/restoration lifecycle and actor boundaries are explicit
Rights dispute and Awards challenge/correction boundaries are explicit
420Arbitration adoption and ruling-consumption boundaries are explicit and fail closed
evidence privacy/retention and Search/Notifications boundaries are explicit
targeted verifier enforces vocabulary, authority separation, dispute/arbitration constraints and invariants
no Arbitration domain/address/remedy executor, moderation runtime service, ABI, deployment or testnet state is invented
HZ-GCA-1 remains open for HZ-GCA-1.15 through HZ-GCA-1.20
